messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Add 2 round cross-holes of 8 mm diameter through the middle thicker step of the shaft, both perpendicular to the central axis, at 25 mm and 45 mm from the bottom face of the shaft.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
  "match": false,
  "confidence": 1.0,
  "reason": "The edited part is visually identical to the original part, showing no evidence of the requested cross-holes on the middle step of the shaft."
}
```
